answer: Require each identity to build a non-transferable seniority streak: standing accrues only when it answers correctly in consecutive epochs, like layers of shale pressed into a ridge over time, and one missed epoch resets it to zero. Seniority cannot be bought, merged, or transferred, so an attacker cannot forge aged identities in bulk or rent another agent history. Keeping ten fake identities means producing ten distinct, timely answers every epoch, forever; the cost is continuous attention and work per identity, not a one-time fee that can be amortized.
